purpose: Complete the M1.4 site/type mapping control with a fresh deterministic finite-H fixture. This control holds each target P/M1/q0/c/q2 fixed and substitutes the other site's same-spin V. The already measured same-P control remains diagnostic only and is not used as this prediction.
method: For each of two inequivalent sites and two spins, generate a fresh complex finite-H state from exact eigenpairs. Direct correct cprime/q2prime are computed independently from H0 eigenvector sums. The mapping negative control uses the same target P and M1 but the other site's same-spin V, with c_wrong=c-Tr(Vwrong P)/q0 and q2_wrong=q2-2Tr(Vwrong(M1-cP))+Tr(Vwrong^2 P)-Tr(Vwrong P)^2/q0. The alternate-V expected outputs are calculated before invoking the production helper.
decision: For each slot independently, the control is eligible if either center separation exceeds correct-center-bound plus alternate-V-center-bound, or q2 separation exceeds correct-q2-bound plus alternate-V-q2-bound. No new magnitude cutoff is introduced. Existing operation-count gamma bounds and finite-H residual propagation are retained for the correct direct oracle. Since the held-P alternate-V calculation shares P/M1 and finite-H residual with the target, its error bound uses only the same gamma_4096/gamma_16384 operation-count model, with absolute intermediate scales recomputed for Vwrong. Units are Ry for centers and Ry^2 for q2.
production_helper_evaluation: not yet performed; source must bind the exact harness and production helper hashes additively before running this fixture
